faqs.a: Yes! 100% online so you can learn on your schedule—early mornings, late nights, or weekends.

faqs.q: How long does the program take?
faqs.a: In as little as one year! Complete your 21 credits full-time, or take it at your own pace.

faqs.q: Do I need prior experience in education?
faqs.a: No! No prior experience is required. The program covers all foundational knowledge.

faqs.q: Will I learn special education skills?
faqs.a: Yes! Special education is an in-demand area, and this program gives you foundational skills.
